name: full-onboarding
description: The full sit-down setup for a campus - about 25-30 minutes. Interviews the owner about their business, audience, offers, goals, tools, and voice, and turns each answer into a real working file (not a form dump). This is the DEFAULT path offered at first run (option A of the fork), and the re-entry path any time later. Use when the owner says "/full-onboarding", "full onboarding", "do the full setup", "set up everything properly", "finish my setup", "let's do the whole thing", or picks the full option at the fork. Resumable and non-destructive: on a campus that's already partly set up it picks up at the first file that isn't done and never re-asks what's already drafted or confirmed.
